# Frankpeter

> Senior product designer for AI and SaaS products, working across product, UX, design systems and motion. Previously design lead on Tempo and Shadeform. Currently open to full-time roles.

## Case studies

- [Docwize](https://frankpeter.xyz/docwize): Rebuilding document review and approval for a SaaS document workflow product — inbox, review decisions, signature guard and design system.
- [Woz](https://frankpeter.xyz/woz): Redesigning and building, in Framer, the landing page for Woz, an AI that builds professional mobile apps from a prompt. Live in 10 days.
